Done! I've standardized your Met inventory TSV file and saved it to `/mnt/user-data/outputs/met_inventory_standardized.tsv` for download.

**What I standardized:**

- **Removed HTML entities**: Converted `<i>` and `</i>` tags to plain text
- **Cleaned quotation marks**: Converted fancy/smart quotes to standard straight quotes where appropriate
- **Removed extraneous quotes**: Stripped unnecessary quotation marks from titles while preserving meaningful ones (like titles in quotes)
- **Consistent formatting**: Ensured all 4 columns maintain proper tab separation
- **Preserved all data**: Every object number, date, title, and link remains intact

All 604 records are present and complete—no data loss occurred.
